hypothesis: Complete-block hashing contributes no variation in this workload. Sampling configuration may explain the substantial instruction differences remaining after accounting for prompt length.

pcvs.expression: len(request.prompt_token_ids) if request.prompt_token_ids is not None else 0
pcvs.name: prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Models prompt copying during request construction.

pcvs.expression: int(request.sampling_params is not None and request.sampling_params.temperature > 0)
pcvs.name: random_sampling
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes greedy and random sampling configuration paths.

pcvs.expression: int(request.sampling_params is not None and (request.sampling_params.presence_penalty != 0 or request.sampling_params.frequency_penalty != 0 or request.sampling_params.repetition_penalty != 1))
pcvs.name: penalties_enabled
pcvs.rationale: Separates requests with active penalty settings from baseline requests.

pcvs.expression: request.sampling_params.max_tokens if request.sampling_params is not None else 0
pcvs.name: max_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Exposes the independently varied generation limit transferred into the constructed request.
